author: Antonio Clim
purpose: Executable evidence-bounded interpretation and prospective formative calibration design, not empirical calibration.
prospective_scope: Locked before any S04 acceptance test or calibration evaluation. S03 findings and source are prior information. Implementation corrections retain their negative tests and deviations.

decisions.dimensions: Retain all seven S01 candidate dimensions. Operational interpretation is restricted to per-callable structural observations and parser-scope disclosures. The other five dimensions explicitly abstain: counts are not evidence of naming clarity, documentation alignment, defensive correctness, duplication or dependency hygiene.
decisions.profiles: Three explicit, versioned profiles: observation-only, illustrative structural review and a more conservative structural-review policy. Require profile identifier and exact canonical profile SHA-256. No arbitrary external executable or free-text policy is admitted.
decisions.thresholds: Illustrative policy choices, not learned, universal or empirically calibrated standards. Greater-than predicates use a declared [lower, nominal, upper] threshold set. A review opportunity is stable only above upper; no rule trigger is stable at or below lower. Intermediate values abstain as policy-sensitive. No probability or confidence interval is inferred from this set.
decisions.missingness: Preserve observed, unavailable, insufficient_evidence and not_applicable. No zero imputation. A missing callable series produces explicit dimension-level absence, not an empty favourable judgement. No assertion that no trigger means good quality.
decisions.uncertainty: Separate computational scope, parser/runtime dependence, measurement uncertainty not estimated, policy sensitivity and empirical calibration not established. Retain every qualification with each interpretation. No population error rate or statistical interval is computed from synthetic conformance tests.
decisions.source_admission: Measure supplied bytes with the exact S03 kernel. For transported reports require source-byte replay and exact profile/build checks, not a self-declared digest alone. Consistency checks do not authenticate the source author or a hostile execution environment.
decisions.identity: Separate specification version, implementation file-set digest, actual Git commit/tree and checkout state, runtime identity, profile version/digest and input/evidence identity. Uncommitted or unversioned source must not be labelled as the baseline build.
decisions.error_migration: Keep all S03 bytes and legacy ME codes unchanged. Map (legacy namespace, code) to explicit S04 condition identifiers. Bare ambiguous ME-008 is rejected; kernel unsupported-language refusal and registry Markdown subset limitation are distinct. Apply the same source-qualified rule to any further taxonomy collisions found.
decisions.calibration: No calibration dataset or authorised human study exists in this phase. Implement a manifest-admission interface and prospective evaluation design for action correctness, false prompting, abstention coverage and burden. The interface cannot certify authorisation or return empirical calibration status.
decisions.leakage: Partition before tuning. Exact raw/normalised content, declared lineage and contributor groups cannot cross training, tuning and evaluation splits. Require sealed evaluation labels and frozen profile digest; reject undeclared fields, outcome labels in the admission manifest and origin-classification targets. Manifest checks do not discover unknown near-duplicates or concealed relationships.
decisions.product_boundary: New native interpretation capsule, not a claim that browser/CLI v2 reports implement it. S05 owns production report integration and accessibility. No global scalar, origin inference, automatic grading or sanction operation.

acceptance: A04-01 exact base and additive-only source changes
A04-02 profile identity and closed-field admission
A04-04 all four applicability states and absent series
A04-05 non-compensation across rules and dimensions
A04-06 policy drift changes identity or is rejected
A04-07 no prohibited claim or scalar semantics
A04-08 source replay rejects forged observations, evidence and report fields
A04-09 implementation, specification, runtime and profile identities remain separate
A04-11 leakage and sealed-label manifest negative controls
A04-12 explicit empirical absence and prospective estimands
A04-13 S01/S02 and S03 corrective regressions remain green
A04-14 finite path/LF/CRLF/BOM/renaming/comment policy invariance with declared exceptions
A04-15 SHA-specific native matrix and exact source read-back
A04-16 negative-result ledger, 20-gate update and verified continuity package
execution_design: Independent hand-worked boundary tables and algebraic predicate oracles, deterministic generated threshold cases, adversarial report/profile/manifest mutations and finite source transformations. Test counts are reported after collection, not passed off as independent empirical observations. One justified CI cycle for the final exact candidate across the four S03 native cells; do not rerun the S03 experiment merely for reassurance.
stop: At S04 closure report all acceptance outcomes and residual limits, then await next for S05. Do not modify main, product version, licence, visibility, tag, release or Zenodo.
